Question 3
?

The curve C is the intersection of a surface S, defined by z=f(x,y), with the plane y=−2. Given that the point P(4,−2,5) lies on C, and that fx=yx, find the equations of the tangent line to C at P.

a
{y=−2z=−2x+15
b
{y=−2z=2x+9
c
{y=−2z=2x+21
d
{y=−2z=−4x+9
e
{y=−2z=−4x+21
Submit
